text: analysis_L.py (scoring) did not exist at COMMIT #0; its sha256 is committed in the first family COMMIT #2, before any sweep sample of any family exists. Thresholds, MAE definition and verdict rules are fixed in protocol8L.json at COMMIT #0.
GPU is an RTX A4500 (20 GB) as planned; Qwen/Llama keep the input embedding on the CPU (exact lookup).

BH rival rule corrected before COMMIT #2 (no sweep sample existed): d_H is the argmax of the base paths' mean T-1 entropy over every prefix length < 64 that has locator or refinement continuations (the COMMIT #1 version only searched even grid positions per path and kept the shortest opening). BH openings are committed at COMMIT #2.

L-T1: opening classifier failed its gate ({'unit': 'L-T1', 'n_programs': 37, 'decided_prefixes': 1140, 'decided_agreement': 0.8649122807017544, 'full_agreement': 0.8648648648648649, 'coverage_full': 0.8648648648648649, 'first_decision_p90': 184.0, 'gate_pass': False}); continuations are completed and labelled by the frozen labeller.

L-T1: the opening classifier failed its gate, so every continuation is completed and labelled by the frozen labeller; the extrapolated locator cost exceeded 25 GPU-minutes, so (plan rule) the grid is thinned to 4 base paths and every 4th token beyond k = 32, and continuations are capped at 539 new tokens (1.5 x the fit twin's p90 length + 32; capped continuations are labelled as they stand).

Llama style re-gate: L-T03 agreement 0.10 and L-T06 0.71 (< 0.9). The plan makes the adjudicated column primary for such units; adjudicating every continuation that feeds the law was not feasible in the time box, so primary scoring stays on the frozen labeller (one label space for the law's inputs and outcomes) and the judge-adjudicated sweep labels are reported as a sensitivity. Main disagreement: Llama's T03 programs that count frequencies, push every (count, value) pair into a heap and pop k-1 times are 'heapify_pop' to the frozen AST/runtime labeller but 'other' or 'size_k_heap' to the judges.

Time box (plan drop order item 2): L-T06 dropped after the Llama locators had to run with completion labelling (opening classifiers failed their gates). L-T03 kept (first in the committed selection order) so that 4 held-out units are scored. Its fit twin, selection and re-gate rows stay in the data.

L-T03: opening classifier failed its gate ({'unit': 'L-T03', 'n_programs': 33, 'decided_prefixes': 537, 'decided_agreement': 0.5977653631284916, 'full_agreement': 0.7272727272727273, 'coverage_full': 0.7272727272727273, 'first_decision_p90': 80.0, 'gate_pass': False}); continuations are completed and labelled by the frozen labeller.

L-T03: the opening classifier failed its gate, so every continuation is completed and labelled by the frozen labeller; the extrapolated locator cost exceeded 25 GPU-minutes, so (plan rule) the grid is thinned to 4 base paths and every 4th token beyond k = 32, and continuations are capped at 411 new tokens (1.5 x the fit twin's p90 length + 32; capped continuations are labelled as they stand).

For units whose opening classifier failed its gate (completion labelling: L-T1, L-T03), each second-decision search used 2 base paths (1 per leading algorithm) instead of 4 (cost); at most 2 searches per unit (largest class mass x opening coverage first).

Locator restarts reuse already-sampled continuations by their deterministic id (same prefix, same seed, same engine), so a restarted locator reproduces the same series; no continuation was resampled with a different stream.
Locator nested-opening rule fixed before the Llama/Qwen commits (amendment 2 in the hash chain); Gemma openings are identical under both rules.
Content-addressed ids for forced/second-decision continuations (amendment 3); superseded L-T1 rows kept in data/continuations_superseded.jsonl.

Plan time box: Llama bench units dropped (L-T03 after L-T06) because COMMIT #2-L with them projected past 3.5 h elapsed; the held-out set is therefore G-T04, G-R6 and L-T1 (3 units scored), so the held-out criterion (>= 4 scored) is reported as underpowered rather than passed.
L-T1: 3 classes met the second-decision trigger; only the 2 with the largest T-1 mass x opening coverage were searched (cost cap); the rest keep their empirical Phat.
predict8 bug fix (not-found second decisions keep their empirical Phat), amendment 4, before COMMIT #2-llama.

Llama top-k shadow validation failed (1/20 token-identical at T 1.3: 100 of 100 programs in that cell diverge from top-p and the regenerated tails differ under a different batch composition). The plan fallback (direct top-k cells at N = 50) did not fit the time box; Llama top-k cells are reported but not used for any claim.

Generation caps: Qwen fit twins use iteration 7's caps (A3 640, B6 384, B3 768) so they double as engine checks; sweeps use min(1,024 or 1,536 for the path task, 2 x longest fit program + 8). Only Llama T1 hit its cap (72 programs at T 1.3, degenerate rambling; reported).

Base sub-arm phrasing programs for T1, T10 and T2 are the 20 stored iteration-7 Qwen3-8B twin programs (art_MZAfDPVhM6Ui, same prompts and model) instead of 20 regenerated ones; B3/A3 use this run's fit twins. T2's margin uses iteration 7's 16-token runner-up path (not the 48-token LLR).

Frozen-labeller 'disputed' labels (runtime and AST disagree) are counted in the 'other' bin, as in iteration 7; every correct 'disputed' program the novelty audit listed (8, A3 and B3) was read and is a catalogue algorithm.

After all samples and scoring: src/cfg8.py resolves the dependency art_j3Rm_lr2nzR6 through ART_J3RM_DIR or the sibling folder ../art_j3Rm_lr2nzR6 (portable paths), finalize.sh takes the aii-json skill folder from AII_JSON_SKILL_DIR, and server paths were scrubbed from logs/. No computed quantity changes; the code hashes in COMMIT #0 refer to the earlier versions.
